title: Accounts Receivable Automation Returns on Investment Calculated
summary: Key Takeaways For subscription SaaS, the real ROI of AR automation is churn reduction and upsell lift — not the labor savings most calculators stop at. Automated AR cuts Days Sales Outstanding by 8 to 15 days versus manual processing. Cash application drops from €4-8 per transaction by hand to under €0.50 automated. Automated systems match payments at rates above 95%, killing most reconciliation errors. At €100M revenue, every single day you cut from DSO frees roughly €274,000 in working capital. Labor cost avoidance runs €17,500 to €37,500 a month for a business processing 5,000 payments monthly. Churn and upsell are the hardest numbers to calculate — 1 to 2 days each, versus hours for a payback period. Quick Summary For subscription SaaS, the ROI of AR automation comes down to two numbers your competitors almost never calculate: churn reduction and upsell lift. Faster, cleaner billing keeps subscribers from cancelling over payment friction. That retention math dwarfs the labor savings most calculators stop at.
